Broad technical knowledge across multiple domains including Linux and Windows Server OS, web service stack, networking, migration, data storage, containerization, and DevOps
Experience in scripting languages such as Python, Bash, or PowerShell is an advantage
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and Thai
​

Posts.RecruitPostName: Tencent Cloud Senior Industry Product Operations Manager — Risk Control & Anti-Fraud (Malaysia)
Posts.Responsibility:
Business Unit
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

What the Role Entails
We are looking for a (Senior) Industry Product Operations Manager with solid experience in risk control, anti-fraud, business security, and financial risk management, as well as strong commercialisation capabilities and bilingual communication skills in native language and English.
This role will be responsible for supporting the commercialisation and solution delivery of Tencent Cloud Risk Control Solution, TCRS, in overseas markets. The position will serve as a critical bridge between product, sales, solution, delivery, and client teams.
The successful candidate will be expected to deeply understand overseas clients’ risk challenges across scenarios such as registration, login, marketing campaigns, transactions, payments, credit application, account security, and user lifecycle management. The candidate will translate Tencent Cloud’s capabilities in business security, risk identification, anti-fraud, device risk, account security, payment risk control, and financial risk management into industry solutions that are sellable, deliverable, and scalable.
This role requires not only strong technical understanding, but also strong business acumen, client communication skills, and solution packaging capabilities. The candidate will support overseas sales teams throughout the full sales cycle, including requirement discovery, solution design, client presentation, product demonstration, POC execution, pricing support, and commercial conversion.1. Drive Overseas Commercialisation of TCRSLead the solution design and commercial landing of Tencent Cloud TCRS products in overseas markets, covering risk control, anti-fraud, and financial risk management.
Develop industry-specific solutions for clients in fintech, digital banking, consumer finance, payments, e-commerce, gaming, content platforms, and social networking.
Translate TCRS capabilities, including device risk, account security, transaction risk control, payment risk control, credit risk control, rule engines, and model scoring, into clear business value that clients can understand.
2. Support the End-to-End Overseas Sales ProcessSupport sales, business development, and channel teams in client requirement discovery, solution design, technical engagement, product demonstration, POC execution, and pricing support.
Independently conduct product introductions, solution walkthroughs, technical Q&A, and value presentations to clients in both native language and English.
Help identify clients’ real pain points, purchasing motivations, and decision-making processes, and drive opportunities from the requirement stage to POC, quotation, and contract signing.
3. Design Anti-Fraud and Business Security SolutionsAnalyse client risk issues and design solutions across scenarios such as registration, login, marketing, transactions, payments, and account security.
Cover typical risk cases including fake registration, account theft, marketing abuse, promotion abuse, card-not-present fraud, chargebacks, account takeover, and organised fraud.
Design localised risk control solutions by combining capabilities such as device risk, behavioural risk, IP risk, account risk, relationship networks, rules, and machine learning models.
4. Support Financial Risk Management SolutionsDesign pre-loan, in-loan, and post-loan risk management solutions for financial clients, including digital banks, consumer finance companies, cash loan providers, BNPL platforms, payment institutions, and e-wallets.
Cover key scenarios such as identity verification, application fraud detection, credit assessment, credit approval, limit management, transaction monitoring, post-loan early warning, and collection segmentation.
Support financial clients in POC test design, performance evaluation, strategy optimisation, and business value assessment.
5. Drive Product Requirement ClosureCollect overseas client requirements related to anti-fraud, payment risk control, credit risk management, and compliance risk management, and translate them into product requirements and implementation roadmaps.
Work closely with product, R&D, algorithm, data, delivery, and sales teams to convert client requirements into product capabilities.
Consolidate project experience from key accounts and develop standardised industry solutions, case studies, POC templates, and sales enablement tools.
6. Sales Enablement and Market InsightsDeliver product training, industry training, case study training, and competitor training to sales, business development, channel, and partner teams.
Produce materials such as product introductions, industry solution decks, client case studies, FAQs, competitor analysis, and deployment documentation.
Track overseas trends in risk control, anti-fraud, fintech, and compliance, and provide input to support the overseas GTM strategy of TCRS.

Who We Look For
Bachelor’s degree or above; 
Minimum 5 years of experience in internet risk control, anti-fraud, business security, fintech risk management, payment risk control, credit risk management, or related fields.
Excellent bilingual communication skills in native language and English, with the ability to conduct client communication, solution presentations, business discussions, document drafting, and cross-border team collaboration in English. Madarin Speaking skill is a Plus.
Strong client-facing communication skills and business understanding, with the ability to independently conduct requirement discovery, solution articulation, and value presentation.
Strong cross-functional collaboration capabilities, with the ability to coordinate product, R&D, algorithm, delivery, sales, and partner resources to drive complex projects to successful delivery.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.
Work Location: Malaysia-Kuala Lumpur

Business Unit
LIGHTSPEED STUDIOS is made up of passionate players who advance the art & science of game development through great stories, great gameplay, and advanced technology. We are focused on bringing next generation experiences to gamers who want to enjoy them anywhere, anytime, across multiple genres and devices.

About the Hiring Team
Lightspeed Tech Center is a R&D department under Lightspeed Studios which develop PUBG Mobile and other high-quality games. Our Tech Center leads the research, exploration, and discovery of innovative technologies and provides technical services for all games during all phases of life cycle, including engine, audio, QA, AI, next generation game, technical cooperation, etc.

What the Role Entails
Track domestic and international cutting-edge developments in AI generative models and intelligent agents (AI Agents), conduct market research and trend analysis on AIGC technologies, products, and applications.
Assist product managers in driving the application of AIGC technologies in gaming, combining insights into gaming business and evaluations of LLM/Agent model capabilities to formulate technical implementation plans.
Design innovative solutions integrating gameplay with AI agents, coordinate resources to ensure high-quality project delivery.
Develop data and technical standards for AIGC/AI Agent-related gaming products, design scenario-based application solutions, and operational demonstration plans.
Explore deep integration of AI agents into gaming scenarios (e.g., NPC interactions, procedural content generation, dynamic narratives), and optimize synergies between technical capabilities and user experience.

Who We Look For
Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI, Data Science, or related fields.
Passion for the gaming and internet industries; familiarity with AI agent principles and frameworks; prior experience in technical prototyping or scenario-based implementation is a plus.
Basic understanding of development, testing, and operational workflows; strong product mindset and analytical skills.
Exceptional creativity and systematic design ability, capable of independently drafting requirements documentation and coordinating cross-team communication.
Bonus points：
AI Technical Proficiency: Solid grasp of AI fundamentals and mainstream algorithms, with deep expertise in at least one AI domain (e.g., generative models, reinforcement learning) and its practical limitations.
AI Agent Expertise: Hands-on experience researching AI agent technologies, familiarity with mainstream frameworks, and awareness of deployment challenges.
Gaming AI Experience: Prior work applying AI in gaming contexts (e.g., smart NPCs, dynamic environment generation, player behavior prediction).
